intents_zh: 用向量庫 + LLM 做 QA
code:
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
from openai import OpenAI
import numpy as np

embedder = SentenceTransformer("{{embed_model}}")
llm = OpenAI()
DOCS, VECS = [], None

def ingest(docs: list[str]):
    global DOCS, VECS
    DOCS = docs
    VECS = embedder.encode(docs, normalize_embeddings=True)

def retrieve(q: str):
    qv = embedder.encode([q], normalize_embeddings=True)
    sims = (VECS @ qv.T).flatten()
    idx = np.argsort(-sims)[:{{top_k}}]
    return [DOCS[i] for i in idx]

def answer(q: str) -> str:
    ctx = "\n".join(retrieve(q))
    r = llm.chat.completions.create(
        model="{{llm_model}}",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": f"Context:\n{ctx}\n\nQ: {q}"}],
    )
    return r.choices[0].message.content
